caption: Hebrews explicitly compares Jesus with the Day of Atonement. It is strong Christian typology—but Leviticus gives ritual instructions, not a forecast.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did this ritual predict Jesus? On the Day of Atonement, the high priest entered the inner sanctuary with sacrificial blood. Hebrews compares that rite with Jesus.
slides.body: On the Day of Atonement, the high priest entered the inner sanctuary with sacrificial blood. Hebrews compares that rite with Jesus.
slides.heading: Did this ritual predict Jesus?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Lev 16:15-17: Aaron shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and bring its blood behind the veil.
